summary: BANKNIFTY at Quote before any REST index quote: the feed looks its streaming id (-25) up over REST as it subscribes, as the web does, and streams it (audit RB-05).

notes: The web's adapter fetches the listingId at subscribe (samco_adapter.py _get_index_listing_id, BrokerData.get_index_listing_id over /quote/indexQuote); the glue answers it with the same id. The desktop's step is Broker::feed_presubscribe (brokers/samco/presubscribe.rs).
